> 所有示例严格遵循官方 ref-en.txt 六段式结构，总字符数控制在 4000 以内（H3 API 硬限制）。detailed_description 控制在 180-220 英文词。

## 示例 1：3 张图（模特场景图 + 服装正面 + 服装背面）· 经典走秀展示 · 10秒

subject_definitions:
<Subject 1> is the female model in <Picture 1>, with long wavy dark brown hair and a slender build.
<Subject 2> is the modern minimalist living room in <Picture 1>, with large windows casting soft natural daylight, a beige sofa, and a wooden coffee table.
<Subject 3> is the garment whose front comes from <Picture 2> and back from <Picture 3>, a black off-the-shoulder floral lace long-sleeve top with sheer sleeves, peplum waist, and a center back seam with ruched gathers.
<Picture 1> is the opening frame anchor of [Shot 1].

summary:
[reference generation] The target video shows <Subject 1> walking toward the camera in <Subject 2> wearing <Subject 3>, with the camera pushing in to an upper-body close-up, then a 180-degree turn to reveal the garment back, settling into a final pose.

retention_analysis:
<Subject 1> (appears in [Shot 1]): fully_preserved - model's face, hair, and body proportions retained.
<Subject 2> (appears in [Shot 1]): fully_preserved - living room, window light, and furniture retained.
<Subject 3> (appears in [Shot 1]): fully_preserved - black color, off-the-shoulder neckline, floral lace, sheer sleeves, peplum waist, and back seam with ruched gathers retained.
<Picture 1> ([Shot 1] opening): fully_preserved - initial full-body composition and scene layout match.

detailed_description:
The target video uses a cinematic high-fashion style with soft natural lighting.
[Shot 1] The shot opens from <Picture 1> with <Subject 1> standing full-body in <Subject 2>, wearing <Subject 3>. She walks confidently toward the camera, heeled sandals tapping the wooden floor, lace sleeves swaying. The camera slowly pushes in to a medium close-up, filling the frame with her upper body and showcasing the off-the-shoulder neckline and floral lace texture. She pauses, then smoothly rotates 180 degrees on the spot, the lace fabric shifting fluidly, her hair sweeping aside to reveal the back of <Subject 3> with its center seam and ruched gathers. She holds the back pose, then glances back over her shoulder, settling into a poised final stance, preserving appearance, clothing, colors, and scene throughout.

overall_soundscape:
Heeled sandals tap the wooden floor with each step, lace fabric rustles softly during the turn, and a quiet room ambience persists.

non_diegetic_music:
A minimalist piano melody at a slow tempo with soft sustained synthesizer pad chords, maintaining steady understated volume.

## 示例 2：2 张图（模特场景图 + 服装正面）· 优雅定点展示 · 10秒

subject_definitions:
<Subject 1> is the female model in <Picture 1>, with blonde side-braided hair and sun-kissed skin.
<Subject 2> is the tropical beach boardwalk in <Picture 1>, with weathered wooden planks, palm trees, bright sunlight, and ocean in the background.
<Subject 3> is the garment whose front comes from <Picture 2>, a cream V-neck lace mini dress with bell sleeves, a front waist tie, and floral lace pattern.
<Picture 1> is the opening frame anchor of [Shot 1].

summary:
[reference generation] The target video shows <Subject 1> walking barefoot toward the camera along <Subject 2> wearing <Subject 3>, with the camera pushing in to an upper-body close-up, then a subtle side rotation (no more than 45 degrees) to display the silhouette, settling into a final pose.

retention_analysis:
<Subject 1> (appears in [Shot 1]): fully_preserved - model's blonde braided hair, skin, face, and proportions retained.
<Subject 2> (appears in [Shot 1]): fully_preserved - boardwalk, palm trees, sunlight, and ocean background retained.
<Subject 3> (appears in [Shot 1]): fully_preserved - cream color, V-neck, bell sleeves, waist tie, and floral lace pattern retained from <Picture 2>.
<Picture 1> ([Shot 1] opening): fully_preserved - initial full-body composition and scene layout match.

detailed_description:
The target video uses a bright airy fashion-editorial style with natural sunlight.
[Shot 1] The shot opens from <Picture 1> with <Subject 1> standing barefoot full-body on <Subject 2>, wearing <Subject 3>. She walks naturally toward the camera, bare feet stepping softly on wooden planks, the lightweight lace and bell sleeves fluttering with each stride and coastal breeze. The camera slowly pushes in to a medium close-up, filling the frame with her upper body and showcasing the V-neckline and floral lace texture. She pauses, runs her hand along the lace sleeve, then subtly rotates her torso to her left (no more than 45 degrees), showcasing the side silhouette and bell sleeve movement. She rotates back to face the camera, settling into a poised standing pose with a soft smile, preserving appearance, clothing, colors, and scene throughout.

overall_soundscape:
Bare feet step softly on wooden planks, ocean waves lap in the distance, palm fronds rustle in the breeze, and lace fabric swishes gently.

non_diegetic_music:
A soft finger-picked acoustic guitar melody at a relaxed tempo with a simple repeating pattern, light and unobtrusive throughout.
